description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents: one Rust binary, one local SQLite database.
name: io.github.asanabrial/leteo

environmentVariables.description: Where the database lives. Defaults to ~/.leteo, and only needs setting for a store kept somewhere else — the server is started by the agent rather than by a person, so it cannot inherit a shell's environment.
environmentVariables.name: LETEO_DATA_DIR

packageArguments.description: Which tools the server exposes. `agent` is the nineteen an agent reaches for while it works; the three that change or count the whole store sit behind `admin`.
packageArguments.name: --tools

title: Leteo
